title: Build Death-Candidate Selectivity And Ranking V2
objective: Build a deterministic V2 priority layer over Task 196 candidates, freeze weights and thresholds on 24 development replays, then evaluate once on eight reserved replays.
moduleGoal: Reduce V1 score saturation and candidate volume while retaining at least 90 percent of anchors and capturing hard challengers at least ten percentage points less often on reserved validation.
observableOutcome: A reproducible per-replay ranked candidate list with high, medium and low priorities plus separate development and reserved-validation metrics.
metricContribution: V1/V2 candidate counts; anchor and hard-challenger capture; capture gap; priority distribution; p50/p90; split-specific results; determinism; bounded coverage and semantic safety.
remainingModuleGap: None if reserved validation meets every declared selectivity criterion; otherwise conclude that current structural features are insufficient and require new evidence rather than further tuning.
hardeningDeferred: No semantic confirmation, ground-truth collection, machine learning, dashboard, victim identity, attribution, teamfight analysis, broad refactor or Task 198.

executionContract.reasoningComplexity: High: tune only on a declared 24-replay development split, freeze a transparent ranking configuration before reserved validation, and preserve strict separation between structural evaluation labels and score inputs.
executionContract.objective: Produce a less saturated, lower-volume deterministic V2 ranking and decide selectivity on a single untouched eight-replay validation split.

acceptanceCriteria: Reserved validation captures at least 90 percent of anchors and hard challengers at least ten percentage points less often than anchors.
V2 emits fewer candidates than V1; p50 and p90 are not both 1.0; all three priority levels are populated.
Two replay_010 executions are byte-identical; all 32 accepted replay ids are represented with zero protected access.
No score input contains anchor or hard-challenger labels and no final fact or attribution is emitted.
If criteria fail, stop with structural_features_insufficient_for_candidate_selectivity and recommend new evidence rather than more tuning.
The final candidate contains one commit, authorized paths only, synchronized clean Git state and a complete report pending Work validation.
